name: Block ID Prompt
description: Prompt for custom block IDs and complete wiki block links to open tasks, with a plan-budget suffix. Ctrl+Shift+Enter refuses Depends-On ⛓️ **DEPENDS ON:** dependency lines. On inbox notes, Ctrl+Shift+Enter asks where the task goes before linking or unlinking, then moves it with the toggle applied (nav inboxRoute v1). Ctrl+Shift+Enter asks which of today's Pomodoros to link into (↵ = current/next, type to filter or name a new one). Project Schedule comes from the ^prj task; a future-scheduled ^prj link is refused only when its date is the sole remaining reason, dependency reasons are reported first, and a direct link raises a Ready ^prj to Next. A tagged #prj_is_blocked ^prj is refused as blocked by its parent project without raising prerequisites. Ctrl+Shift+Enter refuses LINKS with the relation notice and LINKED FROM with the generated-line notice; Pomodoro cleanup skips both.
author: Bryan
